svg.text: Remaining inventory plus cumulative release, and the mass-balance residual with its derived rounding bound
Generated inventory: not applicable (no source term in the solver yet)
Decay loss: not applicable (no decay in the solver yet)
Relative balance residual (solid) and its derived bound (dashed), 1600 °C
Relative balance residual of the inventory (dimensionless)
Sum of both (equals one up to the residual)

The residual is the observed value; the bound is the derived a-posteriori rounding bound of the solver (decision 6), shown beside it and never tightened. Model: STRATO BTCS five-layer spherical finite difference,

package version 1.0.1, commit c9978f0f64b04fe18f312c82c38592f36d05d2f8; registered AGR1-B-M16 geometry; published heating-test diffusion coefficients chosen by the strato-data selection function (register sets

C16-T2 and C16-BUF), evaluated at the test temperature; kernel-only start; constant temperature; decay and generation are not in the solver. This is a numerical comparison, not an experimental validation.
